title: The Wounded Squire
text: A young squire lies bleeding by the road, clutching a sealed letter. "Please... this must reach the capital. I can pay nothing."

choices.label: Carry the letter (−2 HP)
choices.result: The knight delivers it. Somewhere, a family is spared ruin. The knight sleeps badly anyway.

choices.label: Sell the letter (+15g)
choices.result: A spy pays well for secrets. The knight counts coins and does not look back.

choices.label: Walk past
choices.result: The road is long and full of strangers. The knight keeps walking.

title: The Surrendered {enemy}
text: The fight is over. The {enemy} drops their weapon and kneels. "I have kids," they say. Their purse looks heavy.

choices.label: Spare them
choices.result: They vanish into the trees without a word. The knight feels taller, somehow.

choices.label: Take the purse, let them go (+12g)
choices.result: A fair trade, the knight tells itself. A life for a purse. Everyone walks away.

choices.label: Finish it. Take everything (+20g)
choices.result: It is over quickly. The purse was indeed heavy. So is the silence afterwards.

title: The King's Order
text: A royal courier delivers a sealed command: the village of {location} shelters rebels. Burn it. Refusal is treason.

choices.label: Obey. Burn it
choices.result: The crown pays promptly. The smoke follows the knight for miles. No rebels are found in the ashes.

choices.label: Refuse (−5 HP fleeing the guard)
choices.result: The knight rides hard through the night, an outlaw now. The village never learns what it was spared.

choices.label: Warn the village, then burn it empty

success.result: Empty houses burn beautifully. The crown pays. The villagers rebuild elsewhere. A ugly solution that worked.

fail.result: The courier notices the empty streets. 'Treason,' he says quietly. The knight barely escapes the whipping.

title: The Last Ration
text: One ration left in the pack. A starving child sits at the crossroads, too weak to ask. The knight's own stomach growls. (−3 HP tomorrow without food)

choices.label: Give the child the ration (−3 HP)
choices.result: The child eats in silence, then sleeps against the knight's leg. The knight is hungrier. The knight is warmer.

choices.label: Split it (−1 HP)
choices.result: Half each. Nobody is full. Nobody is empty. The mathematics of decency.

choices.label: Eat it yourself
choices.result: The knight eats facing away. Survival is not a sin, the knight repeats. Survival is not a sin.

title: The Burning Barn
text: A barn is alight. Animals scream inside. Across the yard, the farmhouse door hangs open — a strongbox glints within.

success.result: Singed, coughing, the knight kicks open the stalls. The goats are ungrateful. It changes nothing. It changes everything.

fail.result: Too late for some. The knight carries out a single terrified hen and sits in the dirt with it for a while.

choices.label: Take the strongbox (+30g)
choices.result: The box is heavy with somebody's whole life. The screaming stops eventually. The knight is already far away.

choices.label: Ride on
choices.result: Not my fire, the knight thinks. A thought that will return at 3am.

title: The Witch's Bargain
text: A witch offers a trade: +2 strength, permanently. The price is one happy memory. She won't say which one.

choices.label: Accept (+2 STR)
choices.result: The knight's arms swell with new power. Something is missing. A face? A song? It doesn't matter. Probably.

choices.label: Refuse
choices.result: The witch shrugs. 'They always come back,' she says, to no one in particular.

success.result: Turns out witches keep a lot of gold and very little home security. The knight feels strong AND rich.

fail.result: The knight wakes up in a ditch, aching, with a strong suspicion they were briefly a frog.

title: The Gambler's Dice
text: A one-eyed gambler rattles a cup. 'Double your gold or lose it all. Your luck against mine, friend.'

success.result: The dice land kindly. The gambler weeps theatrically. The knight's purse doubles. The knight should never do that again.

fail.result: The gambler scoops the pile in one motion. 'Friend,' he says, already looking past the knight, 'you were born to do that.'

choices.label: Walk away
choices.result: The gambler's laughter follows the knight down the road. Sensible. Boring. Sensible.

choices.label: Challenge him to an honest fight

success.result: One punch. The knight takes only half the pot, for dignity's sake. Dignity is flexible.

fail.result: The gambler has a knife. Of course the gambler has a knife.

title: The Sleeping Dragon
text: A dragon sleeps on a mountain of gold. One loose coin rolls to the knight's feet. The dragon's eye twitches. It is definitely asleep. Probably.

choices.label: Take the one coin and leave (+1g)
choices.result: One coin. Safest theft in history. Somewhere, a dragon dreams of being slightly poorer.

success.result: A bag of dragon gold! The knight doesn't breathe until the cave is a mile behind. Legendary.

fail.result: The dragon was NOT asleep. The knight escapes with burns, no gold, and a new perspective on greed.

success.result: The dragon, impressed and slightly amused, pays the toll of a small cave. 'Come back when you're older,' it rumbles.

fail.result: The dragon was not amused. The knight is mostly intact. Mostly.

title: The Toll Bridge
text: A troll blocks the only bridge for miles. 'Toll,' it grunts. 'Ten gold. Or bones.'

choices.label: Pay the toll (−10g)
choices.result: The troll counts it twice, then waves the knight through. Civilisation, of a kind.

success.result: The troll yields, impressed. It even refunds a previous traveller's toll. Honest combat, dishonest money.

fail.result: Bones nearly paid. The knight limps across, poorer in blood, wiser in trolls.

success.result: Cold, wet, free. The troll watches from the bridge, professionally offended.

fail.result: The current takes the knight's boots and some loose change. The troll laughs for a solid minute.

title: The Mirror Knight
text: In a ruined chapel stands a mirror. The reflection steps out — same armour, same face, but it's smiling. It draws its sword.

success.result: The reflection shatters. The knight stands alone in the chapel, bleeding, stronger, and no longer sure which one won.

fail.result: The reflection sheathes its sword and steps back into the glass. 'Not yet,' it says, in the knight's own voice.

choices.label: Lower your sword and talk
choices.result: They talk until dawn. About choices. About the people who make them. The reflection nods, steps back into the mirror, and leaves a small gift of good fortune.

choices.label: Smash the mirror and run
choices.result: Seven years' bad luck, they say. The knight chooses not to believe that. The knight checks over their shoulder anyway.

title: A Quiet Night
text: No dangers. No strangers. Just a campfire, a sky full of stars, and a knight with time to spare.

choices.label: Rest (+4 HP)
choices.result: Real sleep, the deep kind. The knight wakes up feeling almost new.

choices.label: Train (+1 STR)
choices.result: A thousand practice swings under the stars. The blisters are worth it.

choices.label: Write in the journal
choices.result: The knight writes it all down. The good, the bad, the votes. Somehow, tomorrow feels luckier already.

title: The Traveling Merchant
text: A merchant with suspiciously white teeth displays his wares: 'Potion of health! Finest steel! Mystery box! All genuine, mostly!'

choices.label: Buy the potion (−8g, +5 HP)
choices.result: Tastes like pond water. Works like a miracle. Mostly genuine indeed.

choices.label: Buy the whetstone (−6g, +1 STR)
choices.result: An hour of careful sharpening. The blade sings now. Money well spent.

success.result: Inside: an enchanted gauntlet and a small cake. Best purchase of the knight's life.

fail.result: Inside: a smaller box. Inside that: a note reading 'No refunds.'
